chapter: Peter's band and the Bocage family
title: Freddie Cottrell's father and the size of Peter's band
summary: Cottrell and Bocage's brother played tenor and alto in Peter's band; Peter kept about five pieces, seven at times.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
